text:
elaine (PM): Heads up — planning Q3 inference work. We need to gate what goes into the performance initiative. Customers are pushing for both lower p95 latency and lower token cost. Proposing we triage items by RICE + clear launch criteria. Quick input pls.

raj (Eng Lead): +1. Need hard SLOs per route. Suggest we prioritize features that unblock ~95% of customer traffic: dynamic batching + prefix/KV cache.

alex (ML Eng): dynamic batching -> biggest cost wins for short chat workloads, but can increase p95 at low QPS if not tuned. Quantization autopilot -> steady cost win, low risk to latency.

maria (SRE): can we set rollout gates? p95 latency regressions <= +10ms, error rate < 0.1%. Canary on Dedicated first, then hosted.

jonathan (Product): from customers: Acme told us they need p95 < 150ms and cost -20% for embeddings. They care more about cost for embeddings, latency for chat.

cassie (Solutions): +1 to split by workload: chat vs embeddings. Different launch criteria and sequencing.

elaine (PM): proposal: run two parallel tracks — chat-latency (prefetch + KV cache + batching tweaks) and embeddings-cost (quant + batch combiner). Launch criteria per track:
- chat: p95 <= 120ms on hosted for 90% of routes, no >0.2% error spike
- embeddings: cost per 1M tokens down 15%, 99th percentile latency <= 500ms

alex (ML Eng): sample RICE sketch (very rough):
```
Feature | Reach | Impact | Confidence | Effort | R*I*C/E
Batching tweaks | 60% | 8 | 0.7 | 2w | 168
KV cache | 50% | 6 | 0.6 | 3w | 60
Quant autopilot | 40% | 5 | 0.8 | 4w | 40
```
Numbers illustrative. Please don't treat as final.

raj (Eng Lead): want to add operational cost of rollout: QA + metrics + rollback hooks = ~1.5w per feature. Also consider per-customer feature flags for Dedicated.

elaine (PM): decision check: sequence chat-latency first (higher SLA risk), embeddings-cost second, but parallel squads may run quick spikes. Agree?

maria (SRE): agree. I'll prep canary dashboard and alerts, include client-level breakdowns.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job created: canary/inference/perf-1845124000

elaine (PM): Action items:
- raj: scope batching + KV cache spike, estimate dev + rollout by EOD Fri
- alex: produce perf microbench + refined RICE numbers by Tue
- maria: canary dashboard + alert runbook by Wed
- cassie: notify Acme about proposed sequencing and expected timelines

jonathan (Product): tagging in roadmap board -> /roadmap/inference/perf-track

elaine (PM): thanks all :rocket:
